entry.title: Show HN: Gatling.chat - The Turbo Messenger for LinkedIn (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
entry.summary: Everyone who does a lot of prospecting, networking and sales on Linkedin just knows how painful the native Linkedin messenger is. For another business, I am generating around 100-200 lead-connections per week. Without this product it's really insufferable. So I built this. Gatling.chat is the Turbo Messenger for Linkedin. Inbox-Zero principles. Split inboxes, follow-ups and sequences, snippets, cleared from the keyboard in a beautiful and snappy desktop app. Built to keep your account within LinkedIn's rules on automation.
